## Data Sources

1.  Create google alerts to monitor local news and blogs that reference data portal URL, departments, and community organizations.

2.  Review referrers to data assets from web analytics reports.

3.  Manually monitor local news and blogs.

## Data Methods

The City of San Francisco tracks citations to open data and includes notes about the articles and tools in a spreadsheet. Citation tools, like Zotero, may also be used to organize articles.

The following screenshot of a Power BI report demonstrates the number of articles and blog posts related to open data, data reporting, and events initiating open government transparency between 2009 and 2025. Including notes with links to data sources and newspaper can be used to link articles to data products and provide insights to department data publishers on the use of their data.

![](images/clipboard-powerbi-citations.png){fig-alt="Dashboard screenshot of a Power BI report news citations about open data in Austin, Baton Rouge, and San Francisco"}

## Equitable Access to News

While new opportunities for rich storytelling through narratives and digital tools created by data reporters, there is also a concern that they are not accessible to everyone [@felle2016] and depend on access to devices, internet, and subscriptions to news services.
